title: Grand Blue Season 3

thread.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 • Grand Blue Season 3 - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Many commenters found the episode very funny, especially the chaotic partnership and failed schemes involving Aina and Kohei.
Several commenters praised the character-focused interactions and felt the episode strengthened the appeal of the cast.
The finale was widely seen as an exciting and effective setup for the next season.
Some viewers enjoyed the dramatic ending but were frustrated by the abrupt cliffhanger and wanted immediate continuation.
Multiple commenters appreciated that the episode included a genuinely strong diving sequence alongside the comedy.

notes: The title and page text explicitly identify Grand Blue Season 3, episode 12. Reddit exposed the discussion and comments but did not expose reliable score or total-comment metadata in the retrieved page, so those fields are 0. Opinions are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
